title: Nine Years for One Clear Night
subtitle: 星辰天体 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 星辰天体（宇宙探索·星辰与天体）
meta: 主题语境：星辰天体（宇宙探索·星辰与天体）　|　核心词汇：astronomer　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 astronomer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 an ① astronomer in the next county found a thing in the sky and named it after a woman who had died in 1901. The ② astronomer, meaning the man and not the discovery, had waited nine years for one clear night; an astronomer, my grandfather said, is somebody whose job is mostly weather. He said the weather had been against him since 1948.

Every ③ astronomer my father read about had been wrong about something first, and he said that was the method. Their  astronomer worked in a shed with a nine-inch lens and no heating; an astronomer, my mother said, is the only scientist who is paid to look at the part that is not there. She said the shed was colder than the sky.

My uncle said he was ④ an astronomer of the yard, by which he meant he knew where the moon would be. The ⑤ astronomer, meaning the profession and not the man, is nine parts arithmetic and one part patience, my father said; an astronomer, he said, is the only worker whose mistakes are measured in degrees and forgiven in decades. He said a degree is a very long way.

By 1963 the  astronomer had published nine papers and answered none of my uncle's letters. The ⑥ astronomer came to the school in March and spoke for an hour about a comet nobody could see; an astronomer, my mother said, is the only person who can describe a thing brilliantly while everybody is looking at something else. She said the children loved him for it.

The ⑦ astronomer I remember is the one in the shed, who let me look through the lens once, in 1969. An ⑧ astronomer, my grandfather said in 1972, is the only person who measures distance in time and is not thought odd for it; every astronomer, he said, is looking at the past and calling it the sky. He said that was either wisdom or a kind of stubbornness.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 天文学家（一个人）
B. n. 天文学家（指人本身，与发现相对）
C. n. 天文学家（指三月来学校讲彗星的那一位）
D. n. 天文学家（比喻：院子里看月亮的人）
E. n. 天文学家（指这个职业、这门学问）
F. n. 天文学家（泛指这类人）
G. n. 天文学家（抽象总称）
H. n. 天文学家（指棚屋里那一位）

items.q: an astronomer in the next county
The astronomer, meaning the man and not the discovery
Every astronomer my father read about
The astronomer came to the school in March
An astronomer, my grandfather said in 1972

answers.why: astronomer 意为“天文学家”，1957 年邻县有一位天文学家在天上发现了一个东西，并用一位 1901 年去世的女人的名字命名它。
astronomer 指“人本身”，与发现相对，那位天文学家为了一个晴朗的夜晚等了九年。
astronomer 泛指“天文学家这类人”，父亲读到过的每一位天文学家都先在某件事上错过，他说这就是方法。
astronomer 为比喻义，指院子里看月亮的人，叔叔说他是“院子里的天文学家”，意思是他知道月亮会在哪儿。
astronomer 指“这个职业、这门学问”，与人相对，是九分算术加一分耐心。
astronomer 指三月来学校讲彗星的那一位，那位天文学家三月来到学校，讲了一小时一颗谁也看不见的彗星。
astronomer 指棚屋里那一位，我记得的是棚屋里那位，1969 年他让我透过镜片看过一次。
astronomer 为抽象总称，祖父说天文学家是唯一用时间来量距离、却不被认为古怪的人。
